sentences.text:
Shri B.P.S. Chauhan, Public Prosecutor for the
 respondent/State.
This is first application under Section 438 of CrPC for grant of anticipatory bail.

The applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.99/2018 registered by Police Station - Kotwali Shivpuri District Shivpuri for the offence punishable under Sections 467, 468, 420 of IPC and Section 51, 52, 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2011.

entities.text: Police Station - Kotwali Shivpuri District Shivpuri
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
It is submitted by the counsel for the applicant that he has been made an accused on the basis of confessional statement made by the co-accused, which is not admissible in law.
Per contra, it is submitted by the counsel for the State that on an information given by an informer,
the co-accused was arrested from the spot, from whose possession a huge quantity of spurious ghee was found and he has stated that the said spurious ghee was supplied by the present applicant.
The applicant is still absconding and, therefore, his custodial interrogation is necessary.
Considering the totality of facts and circumstances of the case and the allegations made against the applicant, this Court does not find it to be a fit case for grant of anticipatory bail.
